tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find affectUI components, screens, blocks, illustrations and motion effects for a UI need, e.g. 'chat input with model picker' or 'onboarding checklist'.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Every affectUI item with slug, section, category, free or Pro, and a one-line description.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Docs for one item: install command, usage example, props, keyboard, accessibility and notes.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: The full .tsx source of an item, to write to components/ui/<slug>.tsx when the shadcn CLI isn't available. Pro items need the user's access key in the MCP connection.
